metadata.title: A clear handoff
metadata.description: Fictional team communication practice with a delayed result and two approaches to clarifying the situation.
metadata.author: u-sim example team

patients.name: Alex Morgan (fictional)
patients.context: A fictional adult is awaiting handoff. The incoming team needs a shared understanding of the situation and who will follow up an outstanding result.

history.presentIllness: The current care summary is incomplete in this fictional exercise.

examination.general: Comfortable and speaking with the team

actors.name: Outgoing colleague
actors.brief: Reveal missing context when the learner asks a focused question.

objectives: Agree on ownership of the next step
education.debrief: How did you establish a shared understanding? Who took responsibility for the outstanding result?
education.prerequisites: Familiarity with a local handoff framework
education.rationale: Practice explicit communication and follow-up ownership.

states.title: Receive the handoff
states.learnerNote: The outgoing colleague is ready. How will you establish the shared picture?
states.tutorNote: Offer incomplete context, then respond to the learner’s approach.

states.title: Clarify the context
states.learnerNote: You have clarified the missing information. Agree on the next step.
states.tutorNote: Ask the learner to make ownership explicit.

states.title: Await the update
states.learnerNote: A result is pending. Agree who will review it while the simulated clock advances.
states.tutorNote: Advance simulated time to allow the update.

states.title: The update arrives
states.learnerNote: The pending update is available. Confirm who will communicate the result.

states.title: Handoff complete
states.learnerNote: The team has confirmed the situation and the next step. Pause for reflection.
states.tutorNote: Use the debrief prompts to compare both approaches.

actions.label: Review the summary and pending result
Confirm who will communicate the result

objects.name: Pending handoff update
objects.description: A fictional delayed update used to rehearse follow-up ownership.
objects.result: The requested handoff information is now available. Confirm that the incoming colleague has received it.
